content_of_post_to_comment:
What works better for treating social media addiction? I am considering two options:

A) time limit of 15 min daily allowance for social media

B) strictly block all digital device use at home

Does anyone have experience with either of these two options?
comment: A strict block at home would have been too easy for me to work around by finding excuses to leave. The 15-minute limit at least made me notice how often I reached for apps out of habit. I'd also ask yourself whether the problem is the phone itself or just specific social media apps.
